articles.title: Ten reasons the market is selling off again before Thanksgiving
articles.summary: Sozzi Unleashed host Brian Sozzi runs through his list of 10 reasons stocks are selling off again two days after the Jensen Huang relief rally, from a hot PCE report and a possible December Fed hike to new tariffs of up to 20% on China and the EU, and five reasons Nvidia is back under pressure. He questions why Wall Street is shrugging off blowout quarters from Dell and HPE, with HPE CEO Antonio Neri weighing in on server pricing and why the company won't finance neoclouds. Yorkville Ives partner Dan Ives joins to argue the selloff is a growth scare, not a bubble, puts fair value on Anthropic as it trades below its IPO price, and previews Huang's testimony in Washington. Brian closes with Walmart's CFO on turkey sales, a look at retail stocks as gas prices fall for 31 straight days, and a Thanksgiving message to investors.

articles.title: BMO cuts Abercrombie & Fitch rating after post-earnings rally, lifts target
